zh.title: 阿提哈德航空廣播稱中國台灣 外交部嚴正抗議要求更正
zh.summary: 外交部抗議阿提哈德航空廣播稱中國台灣，已協調民航局向總部交涉。
body: 有旅客近日在社群平台反映，日前搭乘阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）自阿布達比飛往台灣的航班。降落前，機上中文廣播稱「歡迎回到中國台灣」，並稱若攜帶肉品入境，「中國政府」將會課處罰款。
對此，中華民國外交部於8月21日表達強烈抗議，並嚴正重申台灣是主權獨立國家，與中華人民共和國互不隸屬。外交部強調，任何矮化台灣主權地位的不當作法，政府與全體民眾絕不接受。
外交部發言人蕭光偉指出，外交部已責成駐杜拜辦事處並協調交通部民航局，向阿提哈德航空總部及在台代表提出嚴正交涉，要求其更正不當用語、道歉並提出改進作為。

en.title: Taiwan Protests Etihad Airways In-Flight Announcement Calling Taiwan 'China Taiwan'
en.summary: Taiwan's MOFA protested Etihad Airways over a cabin announcement calling Taiwan 'China Taiwan' on August 21.
body: A passenger recently reported on social media that during a flight from Abu Dhabi to Taiwan on Etihad Airways, the Chinese-language cabin announcement welcomed passengers to 'China Taiwan' and warned that the 'Chinese government' would issue fines for bringing meat products.

In response, Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) issued a strong protest on August 21. MOFA reiterated that Taiwan is a sovereign and independent country and is not subordinate to the People's Republic of China, stating that any attempt to demean Taiwan's sovereignty is unacceptable.

MOFA spokesperson Hsiao Kuang-wei stated that the ministry has instructed its Dubai office and coordinated with the Civil Aeronautics Administration to lodge representations with Etihad Airways' headquarters and its representative in Taiwan, demanding a correction, an apology, and future improvements.

zh.title: 仁川機場第一航廈櫃檯加裝圍欄 防範插隊與維持出境秩序
zh.summary: 仁川機場1號航廈櫃檯增設實體圍欄；派駐安全人員並防範旅客插隊爭議
body: 南韓仁川國際機場（ICN）於第一航廈報到櫃檯周邊安裝實體圍欄，以防止旅客插隊搶先報到。這項措施源於2026年7月在網路上引發廣泛關注的現場影片，影片顯示多名旅客在航廈內蜂湧奔向報到櫃檯，引發現場秩序與安全疑慮。
根據仁川國際機場公社說明，圍欄已設置於第一航廈出境大廳E區報到櫃檯周邊，並於透明面板上貼上告示貼紙，以維護視覺辨識度並防止旅客誤撞。此外，機場當局已增派現場安全人員進行巡視，並透過數位螢幕顯示警告訊息，明確指出若工作人員安全受到威脅，機場得拒絕提供報到服務。機場主管表示，自相關防護措施實施以來，已未再發生插隊事件。
此類衝突起因於2026年7月2日的一起事件，當時網路上流傳的影片顯示，數十名預計搭乘飛往中國航班的旅客，在第一航廈出境大廳衝向報到櫃檯。相關旅客繞過原本設為折線型的可收縮帶狀圍欄，直接將行李推車推入或繞過圍欄搶先排隊。南韓當地媒體報導指出，在2026年7月2日至7月10日期間，至少發生過五起類似的擁擠衝撞事件，並有數名機場員工在試圖引導旅客回到指定排隊動線時受傷，出現瘀傷與擦傷。
仁川機場官員將部分擁擠原因歸因於近期仁川至中國主要航線的機型調配變更。部分航班由空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）更換為載客量較大的空中巴士A350，使每班次座位數增加約100個，導致更多旅客在相同時段集中湧入報到櫃檯。統計數據顯示，仁川國際機場在2026年上半年共處理3,839萬人次國際旅客，較去年同期成長6.3%。

en.title: Incheon Airport Installs Counter Barrier in Terminal 1 Following Queue-Jumping Incidents
en.summary: Incheon Airport installed barriers at Terminal 1 check-in counters following queue-jumping incidents on China flights.
body: Incheon International Airport (ICN) in South Korea has installed a fence around check-in counter E in Terminal 1 to prevent passengers from jumping queues, following viral videos of crowd surges in July 2026. The protective barrier was implemented after videos showed travelers rushing toward departure counters, raising operational and safety concerns among airport management.

According to the Incheon International Airport Corporation, transparent panels of the new fence were equipped with safety stickers to increase visibility and prevent accidental collisions by passengers. In addition to the physical structure, airport authorities deployed extra security personnel to monitor the departure hall and introduced digital warning displays stating that check-in services could be denied if the safety of airport staff is threatened. Official sources reported that no further queue-jumping incidents have been observed since the implementation of these measures.

The interventions follow a July 2, 2026 incident where footage showed dozens of passengers heading toward check-in counters for a China-bound flight in Terminal 1. Bypassing designated zigzag lines created by retractable belt barriers, travelers pushed luggage carts around or underneath barriers to bypass waiting lines. South Korean media reported that at least five similar crowd surge events occurred between July 2 and July 10, resulting in minor injuries, including bruises and abrasions, to several airport employees who attempted to redirect crowd flow.

Airport officials attributed part of the overcrowding to recent aircraft upgauging on major routes between Incheon and China, where operators shifted from the Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) to the larger Airbus A350, adding approximately 100 seats per flight. The increased passenger capacity led to concentrated arrivals at check-in counters during specific departure windows. Incheon Airport handled 38.39 million international passengers in the first half of 2026, marking a 6.3% increase compared to the same period in the previous year.
